options: Only if the Supreme Court allows
No, it remains in effect until repealed by Parliament
Only if the Chief Minister changes
solution: This ensures that legislative uniformity is maintained among the states.

question: What is the responsibility of the states according to Article 256?
options: Refusing all the orders of the Centre
Not reporting your report to the Center
solution: The Center can also give necessary instructions to the states in this regard.

question: Who is the Chairman of Inter-State Council?
options: The President of India constitutes the President's Council.
solution: The Chief Ministers of all the states also participate in the council.

question: Who pays the expenses when the State entrusts the work to the Center under Article 258A?
options: Payment is made from public donations
The central government itself is doing the work but it is for the state.
solution: Arrangements for arbitration have also been made in case of dispute over the amount of expenditure.
